Her figure is divided into 4 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 57% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 3 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 34%, 54% and 85% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. The regions alternate between 2 materials in a repeating order. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, wisteria formations in ELECTRIC VIOLET and STARK WHITE, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries UV-reactive neon bodypaint, invisible under standard light but ion storm formations in ELECTRIC VIOLET and CYAN glowing at full intensity under her own dedicated UV blacklight. Region 3 is the ring between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries the same material as Region 1. Region 4 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it carries the same material as Region 2. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: full frontal, both hands framing the face, chin raised, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed. A standard hard key light illuminates most of her body; a separate dedicated UV blacklight illuminates the UV-reactive region specifically, making it glow at full intensity while the rest reads under normal light.
